tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: NGX All-Share Index level and daily change, market capitalisation, volume, value, deals and breadth (advancers, decliners, unchanged). Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_market_status
tools.description: Is the NGX open right now? Weekend and Nigerian public-holiday aware. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: list_stocks
tools.description: Every listed NGX equity in one call: price, previous close, open/high/low, change, 7-day change, volume, value, trades, market cap, shares outstanding and sector. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Daily open, high, low, close and volume for one NGX stock, from May 2000 to today. Plan: Free+. Free keys get the last 7 days. Starter and above get the full daily history back to May 2000.

tools.name: list_indices
tools.description: All 21 NGX indices: ASI, NGX30, NGX Premium, NGX Pension, Banking, Insurance, Consumer Goods, Oil & Gas, Industrial, Lotus Islamic, ASeM and more, with week, month, year and inception change. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_index
tools.description: One NGX index by code or slug. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_index_history
tools.description: Daily closing levels for any NGX index, including the full All-Share Index history. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_index_intraday
tools.description: Today's intraday points for an index (level, change, value and volume traded) plus the latest live reading. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: list_etfs
tools.description: Every NGX exchange-traded fund with ISIN, issuer, previous close, open/high/low, change, trades, volume and value. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_etf
tools.description: One ETF by symbol. Common aliases are resolved to the canonical NGX symbol. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_fundamentals
tools.description: Valuation, profitability, leverage and dividend metrics for 145 NGX stocks in one call: P/E, forward P/E, EPS, dividend per share, dividend yield, beta, ROE, ROA, P/B, debt/equity, margins, plus EV/EBITDA, PEG, F-score, RSI and analyst consensus. Plan: Starter+.

tools.name: lookup_identifiers
tools.description: Maps every NGX ticker to its ISIN and FIGI. 152 securities, 147 with a verified ISIN. Resolve an ISIN or FIGI back to a ticker. Plan: Starter+.

tools.name: get_disclosures
tools.description: NGX corporate filings: financial statements, board meeting notices, dividend declarations, director dealings, AGM notices and more, with links to the original PDFs. Plan: Starter+.

tools.name: get_insider_dealings
tools.description: Structured director-dealing filings: who bought or sold, role, volume, price, total value and holdings after the trade, plus weekly net insider flow and the most active tickers. Plan: Professional+. Professional and above get the full feed. Lower tiers receive a limited preview.

tools.name: get_dividend_history
tools.description: Every dividend a company has paid: amount per share, ex-dividend date, record (qualification) date and payment date. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_dividend_calendar
tools.description: Dividends across the whole market by ex-dividend date. Use `upcoming=true` for what is coming next. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Open and recent NGX public offers, rights issues and IPOs with unit price, opening and closing dates and days remaining. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_bonds
tools.description: Nigerian FGN bonds, Eurobonds, Sukuk and corporate bonds listed on the NGX: issuer, type, currency, coupon, maturity and latest quoted clean price (yield to maturity where published). Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_tbill_auctions
tools.description: CBN Nigerian Treasury Bill auction results: tenor, amount offered, subscribed and allotted, subscription rate, stop rate and yields. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: get_block_trade_flow
tools.description: Net buying and selling in large trades (₦10 million and up) by stock over the last N days: where the big money is going. Plan: Free+.

tools.name: list_nasd_stocks
tools.description: Prices for securities on the NASD OTC Securities Exchange (unlisted Nigerian companies such as NASD Plc, Friesland Campina WAMCO, Central Securities Clearing System and more). Plan: Starter+.

tools.name: get_fx_rates
tools.description: Naira exchange rates against USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, CNY, JPY, GHS, ZAR and AED. Plan: Professional+.

tools.name: get_market_news
tools.description: Latest Nigerian business and capital-market headlines from BusinessDay, Nairametrics, Premium Times, SEC Nigeria and more. Plan: Starter+.

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: Your plan, requests used today, daily limit, per-minute limit and lifetime requests. Plan: Free+.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_insider_dealings, get_offers · Private data: get_dividend_history · Public sink: get_market_summary, get_index_history, get_fundamentals, get_dividend_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_insider_dealings, get_offers · Private data: get_dividend_history · Public sink: get_market_summary, get_index_history, get_fundamentals, get_dividend_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
